skills.description: Reads and writes files as plaintext from an AI agent under transparent-encryption DLP (ESAFENET, TianRui Green Shield, IP-Guard, DSE). Use when the agent built-in Read/Write returns ciphertext: non-standard headers (PK/ZIP, D0CF11E0/OLE), garbage, or markers like %TSD-Header, effsoftecrypt, cdg, 00005b00; when the user mentions 透明加密/DLP/加密软件; or to write a covered file without breaking encryption. A Node.js MCP server (40 tools: typed readers/writers per format, `capability_matrix` capability lookup, `doctor` self-check, and `forensics_headers` / `inventory_encrypted` / `compare_plaintext` / `audit_trail` for byte-level proof) routes each type to a whitelisted process: Office/PDF via Office COM, WPS via WPS COM, OpenDocument via LibreOffice/Word, RTF/email via Word/Outlook, CAD via AutoCAD, archives via 7-Zip, text via fs+Word; plus a pywin32 channel (scripts/*.py) for PPT notes, Access rows, WPS cells, Acrobat PDF editing and Office-to-PDF export. Windows + interactive desktop only. Read paths are read-only and never save the source. Not for machines without DLP, scanned PDFs (no OCR), or already-readable files.

It provides a Node.js MCP Server pattern that reads/writes encrypted files as plaintext by delegating to whitelisted apps (Office/WPS/Outlook/AutoCAD COM or 7-Zip/LibreOffice CLI) via PowerShell, delegating to the existing DLP whitelist (the DLP policy is respected) for Node/Python. Includes a headless-safe Word path and a diagnosis procedure to find which processes are on the encryption-software trust whitelist.
